d:
A controversy has erupted in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar district over the deployment of medical teams outside liquor shops. The administration introduced health check-ups following deaths allegedly caused by spurious liquor in the Banda area. Doctors are conducting blood pressure checks and collecting blood samples to identify health complications. Dr. Sarvesh Jain, a professor at Bundelkhand Medical College, has questioned the administration's decision.
His remarks have sparked a debate over doctors' responsibilities and the government's approach to alcohol-related deaths.
Production: Ritu
